title: ISO/FDIS 15614-1 — Welding procedure test — Edition 3
locator: Final Draft International Standard registered for formal approval; concerns qualification testing of arc/gas welding procedures for steels and arc welding of nickel/nickel alloys.
notes: FDIS不是已发布国际标准；不能代替ISO 15614-1:2017及其修订版作为当前合同验收文本。须持续核查最终出版日期/版本。
